minutes.headline: Sewer Commission approved its 40B letter to the ZBA, a grease trap compliance letter, and the Fitchburg IMA.
minutes.summary: The commission tabled the FY15 capital plan on the DPW's advice. It approved a letter to the ZBA on the Lunenburg Village 40B modification and a grease trap compliance letter to food establishments. It also approved the Fitchburg intermunicipal agreement for selectmen sign-off. A resident raised the unfinished Lancaster Avenue sewer cleanup, and the board discussed the contractor's bond.

public_comment.topic: Asked when final cleanup on Lancaster Avenue would be finished and what the town's role is over the contractor.
A resident questioned the grease trap rule: definition of a food establishment, monthly reporting burden, and coverage of churches.
Reported that the Board of Selectmen have received copies of the Fitchburg IMA package.

votes.motion: Accept the letter to the Zoning Board of Appeals on the Lunenburg Village 40B modification as written.
Send the draft grease trap compliance letter with enclosures to food establishments.
Accept the Fitchburg IMA and send it out for final sign-offs.

budget_items.what_was_said: The chair said illegal connections carry a minimum fine and daily fines, waived if corrected by end of October.

budget_items.topic: Sewer connection fees for Lunenberg Village
budget_items.what_was_said: The letter states the raised connection fee and the project total for 80 units.

budget_items.topic: Inflow and infiltration sewer bank fee
budget_items.what_was_said: A per-bedroom fee for Leominster-required remediation applies to the project.
All 20 new units pay the privilege fee while the original 16 affordable units are waived.
Tiered annual fees by compliance level, reduced if paid before end of October.

budget_items.topic: Lightning strike insurance claim, pump station
budget_items.what_was_said: Insurance reimbursed the repair cost less the deductible.
Monthly bill came in at the expected amount.

budget_items.topic: State workshop on betterments, liens, fees
budget_items.what_was_said: Staff proposed attending a workshop; members agreed the cost was worth it.
The commission will not pay travel time and fuel and wants invoice backup.

decisions.decision: Capital plan for FY15 tabled with nothing submitted, per the DPW's recommendation to wait and work with the contractor.
Staff authorized to send the Highfield plan to Weston and Samson for review, paid between applicant and engineers.
Members agreed staff should attend the state betterments workshop and consider the enterprise fund workshop in November.
Next regular meeting set for October 8 at 7 p.m. at the DPW.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission voted to send the Zoning Board of Appeals a letter on the Lunenburg Village 40B modification, accepted as written.
The commission voted to send a grease trap compliance letter, with enclosures, to food establishments.
The commission voted to accept the Fitchburg intermunicipal agreement and send it out for final sign-offs.
The FY15 capital plan was tabled with nothing submitted, on the DPW's recommendation to wait and work with the contractor.
A resident asked when Lancaster Avenue sewer cleanup would be finished and what role the town has over the contractor.

why_it_matters: The 40B letter sets out the connection and privilege fees that would apply to the Lunenburg Village project, and the grease trap letter would put new permit fees and reporting duties on local food establishments.
The Fitchburg agreement governs how the town's sewage is handled and billed, so its terms bear on sewer rates, and the unfinished Lancaster Avenue cleanup is still unresolved for neighbors there.

Selectmen sign-off on the Fitchburg intermunicipal agreement, which the commission sent out for final approvals.
